answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of its task identifier and a future drand quicknet pulse, so participants cannot know the challenge before the threshold-signature beacon is published. A raven, gale, or wander-themed task is still bound to that unpredictable value; commit-reveal deadlines then limit replay and expose inconsistent submissions. This raises the cost of precomputation and offline sybil farming without claiming to prevent an attacker from responding online with many identities.
